name: Limarí Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

notes: Limarí is best known for Chardonnay and Syrah, and it also makes Pinot Noir.
Morning fog from the Pacific and mineral-rich soils give fresh wines with a distinct mineral edge.
